title: How upgrades are kept track of
summary: R.E.P.O. remembers what your crew has bought: the game keeps upgrade information, caches it, and models each upgrade as its own thing rather than a number on a save file.
body: An upgrade carries its own information in the game, so what it does and what it costs are properties of that upgrade.
The game also keeps a cached copy of upgrade state, which is how it can show you what you already own without asking you to remember.
Because each upgrade is an item you buy at a stand, the shop between runs is a place you visit rather than a menu you open mid-run.
What this entry does not tell you: prices, how many upgrades exist or the effect of any single one. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: An upgrade is modelled as its own object with its own information.
Upgrade state is cached by the game.
Upgrades are bought at a stand in the between-run shop.
